For more information, visit WPP.com

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Analyst, Data Science
to join Burson’s Insights & Intelligence (I&I)
team.

The I&I team sits at the heart of Burson’s work, turning data into strategic insights that drive storytelling, campaign performance, and business outcomes. With an expanding client roster and growing scopes of work, our best-in-class team supports some of the world’s most recognizable global brands, including The Coca-Cola Company, Verizon, and Google.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their data science career who is excited to apply technical and analytical skills to real-world business, marketing, and communications challenges. Working alongside data scientists, analysts, engineers, and strategists, you’ll support data science, dashboarding, and AI-driven initiatives that turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.

The ideal candidate has 1–2 years of relevant experience
and a strong foundation in Python, SQL, statistics, and data analysis. We’re looking for someone who is intellectually curious, comfortable working with complex datasets, and eager to continue developing their technical and client-facing skills.

What You'll Do

Support the end-to-end delivery of data science and analytics projects, including data preparation, analysis, modeling, visualization, and documentation
Assist with the development, testing, and refinement of predictive models, including time-series, forecasting, and machine learning solutions
Write and maintain code in Python, SQL, and/or R to clean, transform, analyze, and model data
Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities
Support the development and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
Work with structured and unstructured data from APIs, cloud platforms, databases, and other sources
Integrate analytical and predictive outputs into client-ready dashboards, reports, and tools
Build and maintain dashboards and data visualizations using platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker
Assist with evaluating model performance, data quality, and the accuracy of analytical outputs
Translate technical findings into clear business insights and recommendations for non-technical audiences
Support client meetings and presentations by preparing analyses, visualizations, and key takeaways
Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer specific client and business questions
Document methodologies, code, models, and project deliverables
Participate in code reviews and follow established standards and best practices
Support the responsible and effective use of AI across analytics workflows
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, engineers, and strategists across multiple projects

Experience That Contributes To Success

1–2 years of experience in data science, data analytics, data engineering, business intelligence, or a related field, including relevant internship or professional experience
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
Hands-on experience using Python and SQL for data manipulation, analysis, and modeling
Familiarity with Python data science libraries such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn
Foundational understanding of predictive modeling, statistical analysis, machine learning, and forecasting
Exposure to analytical techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, optimization, or time-series analysis
Experience with dashboarding and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes, APIs, relational databases, and data pipelines
Exposure to cloud data platforms such as AWS or Redshift is a plus
Foundational understanding of data modeling concepts, including star and snowflake schemas
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to non-technical audiences
Ability to manage priorities and contribute across multiple projects in a collaborative environment
Experience in PR, communications, advertising, marketing analytics, or another client-service environment is a plus
Curiosity and a strong desire to continue developing technical, business, and client-facing skills
Commitment to using data and AI thoughtfully, responsibly, and effectively

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.

$35,000—$75,000 USD

You Belong At Burson

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

jobs.description:
Title

CAD Drafter (Temporary)

Job type

Temporary, three to four months, non-exempt, hourly
Full-time (8 hours per day)

Location(s)

Colorado Springs, CO (Remote/Hybrid Considered)

Overview

PteroDynamics is seeking a detail-oriented Temporary CAD Drafter to support our manufacturing team during a 3 - 4 month assignment. In this role, you'll create and update engineering drawings, technical illustrations, and manufacturing documentation that support the production of our innovative Transwing® aircraft systems.

This is an opportunity to contribute to a fast-moving aerospace startup, working closely with engineers and technicians to turn designs and shop-floor feedback into accurate, production-ready documentation.

The position is based in Colorado Springs, CO, with remote or hybrid arrangements considered based on experience and project needs. This position is expected to work 40 hours per week.

About Us

PteroDynamics Inc. designs superior autonomous vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) aircraft systems that fly faster and go farther to reach remote locations without runways, even in harsh conditions. PteroDynamics’ Transwing® aircraft is unlike any other VTOL system, performing like a great fixed-wing aircraft with superb VTOL capabilities.

Transwing aircraft unfold their wings to transition smoothly and quickly between vertical and horizontal flight, overcoming limitations inherent in other VTOL designs by combining fixed-wing aircraft speed, range, and endurance with superior VTOL performance in an efficient, highly automated platform. The Transwing is ideal for automating time-sensitive delivery of critical high-value payloads to hard-to-reach locations, including maritime logistics support, payload delivery to remote locations without airstrips, and reconnaissance and surveillance.

Seeing is believing. Visit www.PteroDynamics.com for details and videos.

Description

As a Temporary CAD Drafter, you'll play an important role in supporting our engineering and manufacturing operations by preparing detailed technical drawings, assembly illustrations, and documentation used throughout the manufacturing process.

You'll work from CAD models, sketches, engineering redlines, and manufacturing feedback to develop clear, accurate drawings and technical packages. This role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to manage multiple priorities, and a practical understanding of how engineering drawings translate into physical hardware.

We're looking for someone who can work independently, collaborate effectively with technical teams, and deliver quality work within established project timelines.

Key Responsibilities

Create and revise engineering drawings for parts, assemblies, tooling, fixtures, and manufacturing applications.
Prepare production-ready drawing packages using CAD models, sketches, redlines, and engineering inputs.
Develop technical illustrations, exploded views, assembly details, and documentation for standard work instructions.
Incorporate engineering changes, manufacturing feedback, and as-built updates into existing drawings.
Apply appropriate dimensions, tolerances, section views, notes, and parts callouts to technical drawings.
Collaborate with design engineers, manufacturing engineers, and technicians to clarify design requirements and resolve drawing discrepancies.
Provide timely drawing revisions and technical illustrations to support ongoing manufacturing and assembly activities.
Maintain drawing accuracy, revision histories, and organized technical documentation.
Support drawing release, configuration management, and document control processes.
Identify and help resolve inconsistencies between drawings, CAD models, bills of materials, work instructions, and physical hardware.
Assist with standardizing drawing templates, symbols, notes, and drafting practices.
Support the development of manufacturing work instructions, inspection aids, and other technical documentation.

Required Qualifications

Minimum of one year of professional experience in drafting, design documentation, or a related engineering or manufacturing environment.
Experience creating and revising engineering drawings for parts, assemblies, tooling, or manufacturing processes.
Proficiency with CAD or drafting software used to develop production drawings and technical documentation.
Ability to interpret 3D models, sketches, engineering redlines, and technical inputs to produce accurate drawings.
Working knowledge of engineering drawing conventions, including dimensions, tolerances, section views, detail views, notes, and revision control.
Ability to create clear technical illustrations and manufacturing documentation.
Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and consistency.
Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with engineers and technicians.
Ability to work independently, prioritize assignments, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Resident Status required.
Ability to collaborate effectively with a team based in Colorado Springs, CO.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with ASME Y14.5 standards and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
Experience in aerospace, unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), composites, automotive, defense, or other complex hardware environments.
Hands-on experience in manufacturing, prototyping, assembly, inspection, maintenance, or related technical work.
Experience developing exploded views, assembly illustrations, standard work instructions, or other technical illustrations.
Familiarity with product lifecycle management (PLM), product data management (PDM), document control, and engineering change processes.
Experience collaborating directly with machinists, technicians, and engineers to resolve technical drawing questions.
Demonstrated ability to balance accuracy and efficiency while managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

Our Values

Our values guide how we work with one another, support our customers, and solve challenging problems:
People: We value relationships with our colleagues and customers while embracing and upholding the worth of every individual.
Excellence: We have a mindset of excellence at all times.
Accountability: We believe the foundation of trust is accountability
Knowledge: We believe that innovation and success depend on gaining, documenting and sharing knowledge

Salary range

$20.00 - $36.00 per hour, depending upon experience.

What We Offer

At PteroDynamics, you will have the opportunity to significantly impact the future of aerial technology through creativity and innovation. PteroDynamics offers eligible employees a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, which includes competitive compensation, stock options, company-sponsored medical insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, long-term disability, paid time off, paid holidays, and paid sick time. All employees enjoy a collaborative, inclusive working environment in an exciting, growing startup company.

Crownlands builds large patient-centric datasets that help us explore biology, discover new medicines, and improve human health. new_jobs.title: Government Subject Matter Expert (SME) - AI Model Evaluation
new_jobs.description:
Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor 

Compensation
: $35-$40 USD/hour, based on relevant experience and project requirements 

Help Shape the Future of AI in Government 

What if your years of experience navigating government regulations, evaluating complex cases, or interpreting public-sector policies could help make artificial intelligence more accurate, reliable, and effective? 
At Volga Partners, we're bringing experienced government professionals into the next generation of AI development. 
We're seeking Government Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)
who can apply their professional knowledge, analytical judgment, and industry experience to evaluate and improve advanced AI models. 
This isn't a traditional government position, and you won't be processing applications or managing government caseloads. Instead, you'll use your expertise to assess how well AI systems interpret information, apply regulations, reason through complex scenarios, and produce accurate, defensible conclusions. 
Your expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement. 

The Opportunity 

As a Government SME, you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized government functions. 
You'll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established regulations, policies, and professional standards. 
Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex public-sector challenges. 

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking 

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas: 
1. Government Policy, Public Records & Regulatory Compliance 

Interpreting federal, state, or local government regulations and policies 

Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), public records, and disclosure requirements 

Privacy compliance, sensitive information protection, and regulatory auditing 

Evaluating complex compliance scenarios and identifying regulatory risks 

2. Government Programs, Eligibility & Administrative Decision-Making 

Interpreting government program requirements and eligibility regulations 

Evaluating complex cases, supporting documentation, and administrative determinations 

Identifying inconsistencies, compliance issues, or unsupported decisions 

Applying professional judgment to regulatory and program-specific scenarios 

3. Government Procurement, Contracts & Vendor Evaluation 

Federal, state, or local government procurement processes 

Request for Proposal (RFP) analysis and evaluation 

Contracting standards, vendor selection, and procurement compliance 

Developing or applying evaluation criteria, scoring methodologies, and defensible recommendations 

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do 

Evaluate AI-generated responses: Review complex government-related scenarios for accuracy, completeness, reasoning, and regulatory alignment. 

Apply expert judgment: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are appropriate, defensible, and supported by relevant policies or regulations. 

Identify errors and gaps: Recognize inaccurate interpretations, flawed assumptions, missing information, and potential compliance concerns. 

Validate against authoritative sources: Use applicable statutes, regulations, agency guidance, and professional standards to verify findings. 

Develop evaluation benchmarks: Help establish high-quality reference responses, assessment criteria, and examples of sound professional reasoning. 

Provide actionable feedback: Clearly explain your evaluations and recommend improvements to AI-generated content. 

Collaborate on quality: Apply project-specific evaluation guidelines and participate in quality reviews to support consistency and accuracy. 

Why Join Volga Partners? 

Put your professional expertise to work in a new way. 

Rather than performing traditional government administrative functions, you'll apply the knowledge you've developed throughout your career to emerging AI technology. 
Contribute to meaningful AI development. 

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI reasoning and improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated information. 
Work remotely with project-based flexibility. 

Participate in specialized assignments from anywhere in the United States, with opportunities for future engagements based on project availability and performance. 
No AI background required. 

We value professionals who understand their field and can recognize when an AI-generated answer is right, wrong, incomplete, or misleading. 

Project Details 

Engagement: Independent contractor, project-based 

Location: Remote, United States only 

Compensation: $35-$40 USD/hour 

Schedule: Variable, based on project assignments and deadlines; weekday or weekend availability may be needed 

Duration: Initial short-term pilot, with potential future project opportunities 

Selection Process: Qualified candidates must successfully complete a skills-based assessment evaluating domain expertise, analytical reasoning, and ability to follow project guidelines 

Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed. Compensation is subject to completion of assigned work in accordance with project instructions and quality standards. 

Ready to Apply Your Expertise to the Future of AI? 

If you've built your career understanding government systems, interpreting regulations, evaluating complex information, or making informed professional assessments, we'd love to hear from you. 

Bring your expertise. Help us build better AI. 

Apply today to be considered for upcoming Government SME opportunities with Volga Partners. 

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced professionals who bring more than familiarity with government processes. You should be comfortable analyzing complex information, exercising independent judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions. 

Required Qualifications 

At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in government operations, public administration, regulatory compliance, government procurement, or a closely related field 

Demonstrated subject matter expertise in at least one of the government specializations outlined above 

Experience interpreting, evaluating, auditing, or applying government policies, regulations, or professional standards 

Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions 

Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings clearly and concisely 

Ability to conduct independent research and validate information using authoritative sources 

Comfort using digital platforms, online research tools, and structured evaluation guidelines 

Current U.S. residency and ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment 

Especially Valuable Experience 

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as: 
Government Policy or Program Analyst 

Senior Regulatory or Compliance Analyst 

Government Auditor or Quality Assurance Specialist 

Public Records or Privacy Compliance Officer 

Government Procurement or Contracting Specialist 

RFP Evaluation or Source Selection Specialist 

Government Program Manager or Senior Eligibility Analyst 

Public Sector Consultant or Regulatory Advisor 

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.
